headline: World Bank Forecasts Crude Oil Prices to Average $79 per Barrel in 2027
summary: The World Bank projects global crude oil prices will average $79 per barrel in 2027, anticipating a 2.5% contraction in global oil demand in 2026 amid ongoing market realignments.
why: World Bank commodity forecasts inform sovereign budgeting, energy policy, and long-term infrastructure planning worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Projections of contracting global oil consumption put downside pressure on multi-year crude benchmark estimates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
